# AppDimens Dynamic

> AppDimens Dynamic is an Android library for responsive `dp`/`sp` scaling with Jetpack Compose and Kotlin/Java (Views) APIs. It ships 14 scaling strategies (Scaled, Percent, Power, Fluid, Auto, Diagonal, Fill, Fit, Interpolated, Logarithmic, Perimeter, Density, Resize, Physical units) over a snapshot-partitioned, lock-free `DimenCache` plus constraint-based resize helpers.

Important notes:
- Kotlin packages: `com.appdimens.dynamic.compose.*` for Jetpack Compose and `com.appdimens.dynamic.code.*` for Views / Kotlin / Java; strategies do not cross-import.
- Modular Maven packaging (since 3.1.6): principal artifact `appdimens-dynamic` (common + core + scaled + plain), one satellite per extra strategy (`appdimens-dynamic-<strategy>`), and `appdimens-dynamic-bom` for version alignment. Kotlin imports are unchanged.
- Current version: **3.1.9** — Min SDK 24, Compile SDK 36, Kotlin & Java 17.
- The recommended default strategy is **Scaled** (`sdp` / `hdp` / `wdp` / `ssp`, optionally `sdpa` for aspect-ratio tuning); the `a` suffix adds aspect-ratio awareness, `i` / `ia` are internal multi-window flags and should not be surfaced to users.
- Since 3.1.8 the cache is partitioned per immutable per-window `DimenMetrics` snapshot — explicit invalidation is not required for correctness; `DimenCache.invalidateOnConfigChange` is a compatibility hook.
- 3.1.9 hardens the single-window fast lane: `metrics + partition` are published as one atomic `@Volatile` `FastPartitionSlot`, eliminating a race that could return a dimension computed for another window/snapshot in multi-window apps.

## Strategy guides

- [Scaled](DOCUMENTATION/scaled.md): Default linear SDP/HDP/WDP curve around a 300 dp reference
- [Percent](DOCUMENTATION/percent.md): Literal fractions of a screen axis (`space*`) plus token-style `psdp`/`phdp`/`pwdp`/`pssp`
- [Power](DOCUMENTATION/power.md): Sublinear growth (exponent < 1) for large screens
- [Fluid](DOCUMENTATION/fluid.md): Band behavior with linear interpolation between reference widths
- [Auto](DOCUMENTATION/auto.md): Breakpoint-style blend (linear + log past threshold)
- [Diagonal](DOCUMENTATION/diagonal.md): Curve on the diagonal screen metric
- [Fill](DOCUMENTATION/fill.md): Cover-like growth using the largest axis
- [Fit](DOCUMENTATION/fit.md): Contain-like growth using the smallest axis
- [Interpolated](DOCUMENTATION/interpolated.md): Piecewise curve between configured points
- [Logarithmic](DOCUMENTATION/logarithmic.md): Log-shaped curve that dampens growth
- [Perimeter](DOCUMENTATION/perimeter.md): Scaling on width + height (perimeter)
- [Density](DOCUMENTATION/density.md): Classic density-based (DPI / 160) scaling
- [Resize](DOCUMENTATION/resize.md): Constraint-based auto-fit (`autoResize*`, `ResizeBound`) — largest size that still fits
- [Physical units](DOCUMENTATION/physical-units.md): Real-world mm / cm / inch helpers
